title: The complete guide to modelling your sales data
author: Acme Analytics Team
html:
The complete guide to modelling your sales data

Good data modelling starts with a clear grain: one row per order, per customer or per day, never a mix. Name tables after what a row represents, keep raw data untouched, and build clean models on top so every dashboard reads from the same definitions.
